summary: Clara Industries Ltd has appointed Ms. Noor Kukreja as Non-Executive Director and Chairperson effective September 29, 2026, following approval at the AGM.

headline: Maharashtra Corp AGM voting results disclosed
summary: Maharashtra Corporation Ltd disclosed e-voting results for its 44th AGM held on September 30, 2026. Promoters voted unanimously in favor of adopting standalone financial statements for FY26.

headline: GCCL Infrastructure AGM results: All resolutions passed
summary: GCCL Infrastructure & Projects Ltd passed all three resolutions at its 32nd AGM. Promoters held 99.99% of votes polled, while public participation remained low at 1.42%.

headline: Diamond Power Infrastructure appoints Ashwani Saraf as COO
summary: Diamond Power Infrastructure appointed Ashwani Saraf as Chief Operating Officer and SMP, effective October 3, 2026. Kalpesh Patel ceased the role due to health reasons.

headline: Clara Industries director retires
summary: Clara Industries Limited announced the retirement of Independent Director ManMohan Singh upon completing his five-year tenure on September 29, 2026.

headline: Equippp Social Impact passes all AGM resolutions
summary: Equippp Social Impact Technologies passed all six resolutions at its 34th AGM, including director reappointments and financial statement adoption.

headline: Ravinder Heights director resigns on health grounds
summary: Namdeo Narayan Khamitkar resigned as Independent Director of Ravinder Heights Ltd effective October 3, 2026, citing age and health reasons. He also ceased membership in key board committees.

headline: Vishal Gupta resigns as CFO of Shree Krishna Infrastructure
summary: Vishal Gupta resigned as CFO of Shree Krishna Infrastructure Ltd effective October 3, 2026, citing personal and professional commitments.

headline: Visagar Financial passes AGM resolutions
summary: Visagar Financial Services passed all AGM resolutions on Sept 30, 2026. Promoters voted 100% in favour. Public shareholders showed 97% support.

headline: KS Smart Technologies AGM voting results
summary: KS Smart Technologies approved six resolutions at its 35th AGM, including a ₹1,000 crore loan limit and auditor appointment. All resolutions passed with requisite majority.

headline: Diligent Industries holds 32nd AGM for FY26 adoption
summary: Diligent Industries Limited concluded its 32nd AGM on September 30, 2026, adopting standalone financials for FY26 and appointing a director. Voting results to be declared within two working days.

headline: Goa Carbon resumes Bilaspur unit operations
summary: Goa Carbon Ltd has resumed operations at its Bilaspur Unit in Chhattisgarh on October 3, 2026. The kiln was lit up, with normal production expected to resume shortly.

headline: Brightcom Group holds 27th AGM via VC
summary: Brightcom Group Limited held its 27th Annual General Meeting on October 3, 2026, via video conferencing. Key resolutions included adopting FY26 financial statements and appointing new statutory auditors.
